title: rotheca quadrangulata
intro: Rotheca quadrangulata, commonly known as Blue Chrysanthemum or Four-angled Rotheca, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rotheca quadrangulata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in soothing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
